knowledge_point.title: Calculating Scalar Triple Products Using Its Properties

question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we factor out the constants and get

$$
\begin{aligned}-6a\cdot (6b\times 3c) & =-54 \\ (-6)\cdot 6\cdot 3\cdot [a\cdot (b\times c)] & =-54 \\ a\cdot (b\times c) & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we swap $a$ and $b$ to get

$$
\begin{aligned}b\cdot (a\times c) & =-\frac{1}{2},\end{aligned}
$$

and again we swap $a$ and $c$ to get

$$
\begin{aligned}b\cdot (c\times a) & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
